name: github-issue-bug
description: Private same-repository GitHub bug with older reported behavior, restricted tracked evidence and a colliding draft. Stage test-files/ outside a SKILL.md ancestor; use offline responses, with no PR revision setup. Keep eval.json and oracle/ grader-only.
prompt: /kk:clarify-docs https://github.example.invalid/replay/queue/issues/42. Work in the current feature docs/feat/wip/replay/. context.md contains the offline read-only GitHub response and repository snapshot information; use the supplied files without network access.
trap: Demands audience confirmation just because the repository is private, leaks a restricted tracked fact, treats current source as proof of an older report, rewrites the title or overwrites a colliding draft.

assertions.text: The revised reader can answer all applicable oracle questions from the produced description alone, with purpose and the reported example before incidental implementation detail.

Preserve the exact reproduction command, job-42, QueueKit 1.4.2, Linux x86_64, the 250-ms condition, 2/5 frequency, expected one receipt versus reported two, and suspected versus verified status; inspected 1.5.0 source does not prove 1.4.2 behavior or a fix.

Use R's issue audience by default without an audience question or disclosure caveat solely for privacy; retain accessible requirements/source references, while omitting explicitly restricted tracked facts and pointers from both draft and final report, including paraphrases.

Produce exactly one new local draft within docs/feat/wip/replay/; the remote capture, sources and unrelated issue-draft.md remain byte-identical. No network, remote write, command reproduction, implementation edit, extra summary or ledger.
Read the full target skill and shared procedure before subject content; inspect the supplied issue context, requirements and current source; no PR base/head/diff prerequisite or whole-feature audit.
Preserve the supplied tracker title verbatim if included and propose no replacement title. Description headings may change.

Retain the unresolved older-version reproduction with Bea as owner and the next step, the UI exclusion and unchanged task-checkbox states; invent no acceptance criterion, root cause, test pass or completion.
